_about: A US 2026-W42 menu from a hellofresh.com capture (HAR 57, 2026-09-29), trimmed to what the website-parity test needs: meal ids, names, categories and tag names; the modularity block (dishes, their options in the site's order, and the Market add-on suggestions that are NOT options); the main-protein filter; the ids HelloFresh's filter service returned for each protein filter the site was asked for (limited to this menu); and the tiles the site showed — unfiltered, one per dish as written (the 86 photos it loaded); under a filter, per dish the dish itself when it matches, else its first matching option (every option photo the site loaded under each filter). No account data: no selection, prices or ratings.
